dos: Keep battery-powered radio and emergency torch charged.
Anchor small fishing boats securely with double mooring lines.
Store adequate clean drinking water and dry rations.
Move to designated high-ground cyclone shelters if advised by authorities.
donts: Do NOT venture out to sea when a red/orange alert is hoisted at ports.
Do NOT enter damaged or flood-weakened structures.
Do NOT spread unverified rumors; follow official radio/IMD bulletins.
